title: Mountain Stream Sounds for Sleeping - Moonlit River Over Mossy Stones, No Music | 8 Hours
description:
8 hours of a clear mountain stream running over mossy stones on a moonlit night. A soft, steady rush with small bubbling ripples close by. No music, no birds, no talking.
The water never loops, with a gentle fade in and a slow fade out at the end. Made for falling asleep, staying asleep, focus and study.
